summary: Add a deterministic CSV formatter to an existing local JavaScript utility.
scope: Implement toCsv(rows, columns) and its specified serialization behavior.
outOfScope: Network endpoints, persistent storage, deployment, and spreadsheet formula interpretation.
profileReason: Bounded pure utility change with no runtime infrastructure or access-control impact.

applicability.reason: The utility must implement the requested caller behavior.
No persistence, migration, or retention behavior changes.
The pure utility introduces no access boundary or credential handling.
Existing JavaScript module and Node test runner are sufficient.
No deployed service, operational target, or recovery topology changes.
No UI, pilot, or user training is part of the utility request.
Independent tests verify exact serialization and failure behavior.
No service or data store is being retired.
